finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache loss took prod down.** One cause, one chain.

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:10 | First `TimeoutError` after 5000ms, store overloaded |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes cap at 502 of 500 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies, `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 reconnect tries failed on the same refused address. Redis never came back. The 173 timeouts and 174 cache miss storms are all downstream noise.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` is refusing. Then cap the request queue so it sheds load instead of eating heap.
